counting: Compiler FunctionTemplate and underlying method observations at the same signature/site are grouped, not counted as two native overloads. This audit is scoped evidence, not a canonical inventory rewrite.

has_initialized_tail.behavior: emplace_new calls has_initialized_tail, scanning all block descriptors until any block.len exceeds the current logical prefix. Sequential growing set_value can therefore inspect an increasing number of blocks. This batch leaves that scan unchanged.
has_initialized_tail.evidence: porting/audits/bvh-sphere-list-hotspot-comparison.json records 62/200 later samples in named has_initialized_tail symbols; implementation predates historical 125s baseline, so this does not establish a new regression or performance improvement.
